timeline.summary: Lokesh Machines issued clarifications on its EGM notice for a preferential issue of equity shares and warrants.
Lokesh Machines issued clarifications on 28 April 2026 regarding its EGM notice for a preferential issue, detailing FY26 warrant allotments and a revised valuation report.
Lokesh Machines received BSE and NSE in-principle approval for the preferential issue of 13 lakh equity shares and 27.78 lakh warrants at ₹181.71 each.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹59.36 Cr (+53.4% YoY), net profit ₹2.15 Cr (+1553.8% YoY).
Mullapudi Lokeswara Rao, on behalf of Lokesh Machines Limited’s promoter group, declared no new share encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026 on April 4, 2026.
Lokesh Machines received a ₹3.14 Cr order from the Indian Army's HQ Eastern Command for 9 MM Carbine Machine Guns, to be executed by April 2027.
